validation: Checked with the structural catalogue gate and deterministic re-authoring. Bundle benchmark 04/11/26 (whole persona core vs no skill, one frontier model, isolated no-tool sessions, deterministic scorers): all 14 closed decision cases at ceiling in both arms; BPMN artefact at ceiling; Lucid artefact 3/5 -> 4/5; two open-ended tasks, two trials each: first working output 4/6, 4/6 -> 6/6, 6/6; standard-look Lucid map 4/8, 4/8 -> 8/8, 7/8 (scorer corrections recorded). Results apply to the bundle as a whole, not to this skill alone; controller-authored cases, not independent review.
sources: Notation facts from the OMG BPMN 2.0.2 specification (formal/13-12-09). Style principles distilled from: Bruce Silver's Method and Style rules as published on the author's site (methodandstyle.com); the Real-Life BPMN authors' published modelling practice (Camunda best-practice guides); eCH-0158 BPMN modelling conventions v1.2 (Verein eCH, 2020); Mendling, Reijers and van der Aalst, Seven Process Modeling Guidelines (2010); Mendling, Reijers and Recker, Activity labeling in process modeling (2010); D. L. Moody's analysis of the BPMN 2.0 visual notation; zur Muehlen and Recker, How much language is enough? (2008). Paraphrased; no source text reproduced.
